# ABBA Manufacturing

> ISO 9001:2015 certified corrugated packaging manufacturer in Pharr, TX. Custom boxes, luxury packaging, and agricultural cold-chain solutions for the Rio Grande Valley and beyond.

## Business Information
- Name: ABBA Manufacturing Inc.
- Location: 9105 S Austin Drive, Pharr, TX 78577
- Phone: (956) 551-6395
- Website: https://abbamfg.com
- Certification: ISO 9001:2015
- Service Area: Rio Grande Valley, South Texas, Reynosa-McAllen Corridor

## Products & Services
- Custom Corrugated Boxes (RSC, die-cut, specialty)
- Luxury Packaging (rigid boxes, custom inserts, branded unboxing)
- Agricultural Cold-Chain Packaging (wax-coated, ventilated produce boxes)
- Point-of-Purchase Displays
- Protective Packaging Inserts
- Short-Run and High-Volume Production
- Design and Engineering Support
